relevance_rank_note: Measures B2 only: surface-to-total ratio and early-endosome colocalisation of APOER2, LRP1, IR and VEGFR in APOE4 vs APOE3 neurons; no ApoE-receptor binding is measured, so it supports the recycling half of H4 by surrogate.

description: Surface biotinylation plus ELISA showed the surface-to-total ratio of APOER2 was about half in APOE4 neurons compared with APOE3.
quote: the ratio of the externally oriented receptors to the total, was significantly lower in APOE4 neurons of APOER2 (Fig. 4A, 53% reduction, p < 0.05)
system: Primary neurons from 1-3 day old APOE3 or APOE4 targeted-replacement mouse pups on an alpha-synuclein-null background, pooled 2-3 pups per culture, assayed at day 21 in vitro; cell-surface biotinylation with receptor-specific ELISA on biotinylated and total lysates, three cohorts each pooling at least two mice. neonatal mouse targeted-replacement neurons on an alpha-synuclein-null background, not human brain cells.
human_check: Legend prints APOE4 = 47.02% of APOE3, i.e. the 53% reduction; recorded as the authors' printed reduction.

description: The same surface biotinylation assay showed the surface-to-total ratio of LRP1 was about half in APOE4 neurons compared with APOE3.
quote: and LRP1 (Fig. 4B, 48.03% reduction, p < 0.05) than those of the corresponding APOE3 cells
system: Primary neurons from 1-3 day old APOE3 or APOE4 targeted-replacement mouse pups on an alpha-synuclein-null background, pooled 2-3 pups per culture, assayed at day 21 in vitro; cell-surface biotinylation with LRP1 ELISA on biotinylated and total lysates, three cohorts each pooling at least two mice. neonatal mouse targeted-replacement neurons on an alpha-synuclein-null background, not human brain cells.

description: Double-label confocal colocalisation showed more APOER2 sitting in Rab5-positive early endosomes in APOE4 neurons than in APOE3, while the early-endosome area itself did not differ by genotype.
quote: more APOER2 is localized in the early endosomes in APOE4 cells as indicated by the M1 colocalization variable described in the material and methods section (0.50±0.03, N = 31 from 3 different preparations) than in the APOE3 cells (0.37±0.04, N = 20 from 3 different preparations) neurons (p < 0.05)
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more ApoER2 retained in early endosomes)
system: Primary neurons from 1-3 day old APOE3 or APOE4 targeted-replacement mouse pups on an alpha-synuclein-null background, pooled 2-3 pups per culture, assayed at day 21 in vitro; double immunofluorescent staining for APOER2 and Rab5, confocal microscopy with M1 colocalisation analysis, 20-31 cells from 3 preparations per genotype. neonatal mouse targeted-replacement neurons on an alpha-synuclein-null background, not human brain cells.
human_check: M1 colocalisation coefficients 0.37 vs 0.50 are printed but the authors print no percentage or fold for this contrast, so eff is qualitative rather than a computed ratio. n is cells, 20-31, from 3 preparations.

description: Insulin receptor colocalisation with Rab5-positive early endosomes was higher in APOE4 neurons than in APOE3 neurons.
quote: the colocalization of IR with early endosomes was significantly higher in APOE4 neurons (0.36±0.02, N = 34 from 4 different preparations) than in the APOE3 neurons (0.28±0.02, N = 48, from 4 different preparations, p < 0.05)
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (more insulin receptor retained in early endosomes)
system: Primary neurons from 1-3 day old APOE3 or APOE4 targeted-replacement mouse pups on an alpha-synuclein-null background, pooled 2-3 pups per culture, assayed at day 21 in vitro; double immunofluorescent staining for IR and Rab5, confocal microscopy with M1 colocalisation analysis, 34-48 cells from 4 preparations per genotype. neonatal mouse targeted-replacement neurons on an alpha-synuclein-null background, not human brain cells.
human_check: M1 values 0.28 vs 0.36 printed; no percentage or fold printed for this contrast, so eff qualitative.

description: Against the endosomal-trapping pattern for the other receptors, LRP1 colocalised LESS with early endosomes in APOE4 neurons than in APOE3 neurons.
quote: LRP1 was significantly more localized to the early endosomes in APOE3 neurons (0.24±0.02) than the APOE4 neurons (0.11±0.01, p < 0.001)
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (LESS LRP1 in early endosomes, opposite to endosomal retention)
system: Primary neurons from 1-3 day old APOE3 or APOE4 targeted-replacement mouse pups on an alpha-synuclein-null background, pooled 2-3 pups per culture, assayed at day 21 in vitro; double immunofluorescent staining for LRP1 and Rab5, confocal microscopy with M1 colocalisation analysis, 21-27 cells from 2 preparations per genotype. neonatal mouse targeted-replacement neurons on an alpha-synuclein-null background, not human brain cells.
human_check: Recorded as against: surface LRP1 falls with APOE4 (Fig 4B) but the receptor is not retained in early endosomes, which cuts against an endosomal-adhesion mechanism for LRP1. Fig 5A legend M1 values 0.24 vs 0.11; the Fig 8A values for the same contrast are 0.22 vs 0.16, a discrepancy between the two panels a person should note.

description: Colocalisation of APOER2 with Rab11-positive recycling endosomes did not differ between APOE4 and APOE3 neurons, a null on the recycling compartment itself.
summary: (APOE3 -> APOE4) -> (no change in ApoER2 in recycling endosomes)
system: Primary neurons from 1-3 day old APOE3 or APOE4 targeted-replacement mouse pups on an alpha-synuclein-null background, pooled 2-3 pups per culture, assayed at day 21 in vitro; double immunofluorescent staining for APOER2 and Rab11, confocal microscopy with M1 colocalisation analysis, 25-37 cells from 2-3 preparations per receptor-compartment pair. neonatal mouse targeted-replacement neurons on an alpha-synuclein-null background, not human brain cells.
